ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var s=String(result);var vo=s.match(/var\s+(\w+)=\{_keyStr/);if(!vo){return '';}var re=new RegExp(vo[1]+"\\.[A-Za-z]+\\('([A-Za-z0-9+\\/=]+)'\\)","g");var m;var out='';while((m=re.exec(s))!==null){out+=java.base64Decode(m[1]);}if(out.length<10){return '【正文获取失败，请检查登录状态】';}return out;})()

loginCheckJs: (function(){try{var b=String(result.body());if(b.indexOf('<title>用户登录')>=0){throw new Error('皮皮小说·登录已失效，请到书源界面重新登录');}}catch(e){if(String(e).indexOf('重新登录')>0){throw e;}}return result;})()
